preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000.
The list p contains n-1 integers representing the edges of the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pi <= i for i, pi in enumerate(p))
preconditions.description: Each element in p is a valid parent index for the corresponding vertex.
The list x contains n integers representing the colors of the vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(xi in [0, 1] for xi in x)
preconditions.description: Each element in x is either 0 (white) or 1 (black).
There is at least one black vertex in the tree.

postconditions.description: The number of ways to split the tree is non-negative.
The number of ways to split the tree is less than 1,000,000,007.
The output is the number of valid splits modulo 1,000,000,007.
